title: FM27 Wonderkids — Football Manager 27 Shortlist Method
description: FM27 wonderkids: why a credible shortlist cannot exist before the 10 November launch, how the FM27 list will be built, and what to check in the Launch Preview.
meta: Football Manager 27 wonderkid shortlist — method first, names when the database ships.
body:
No one has seen the FM27 player database outside Sports Interactive. The game launches on 10 November 2026, and the first build with a browsable database is the free Launch Preview from 29 October. Any page claiming a full FM27 wonderkid list today is either recycling FM26 names or inventing them.

So this page does the part that can be done in October: define what a wonderkid actually is in FM terms, set the bands a credible shortlist has to be built in, and say exactly when the names land.

What FM means by a wonderkid

FM rates every player twice. Current Ability (CA) is what the player is now. Potential Ability (PA) is the ceiling he can reach given the right minutes, training and staff. A wonderkid is the gap between those two numbers at a young age: high PA, low CA, and a development curve that pays off inside your save.

That definition changes what you are shopping for. The target is not the best young player in the game — it is the cheapest player whose ceiling your club can actually reach, and who will still be at your club when he gets there.

Why an FM27 list cannot exist yet

  • The database ships with the game. SI's pre-launch material covers features, platforms and licensing, not player ratings. No attribute data is public before the Launch Preview.
  • The Launch Preview is the first real look — 29 October to 3 November, free on Steam, Epic, the Microsoft Store and Game Pass, all game modes included. Saves started there continue into launch.
  • The scale is large. FM Scout's FM26 wonderkid list reached roughly 940 names by its fourth revision, and was still being updated in June 2026. A single pass at launch does not produce a good list.

How the FM27 shortlist will be built

Every entry will be checked in-game, not copied from a transfer rumour. The build rules:

  • Age window first. The list only takes players young enough to develop inside a normal save. Older "wonderkids" are just good players.
  • PA band, not a single number. Star ratings are relative to your own squad, so an entry records the scout band alongside the club it was read at.
  • Reachability. Fee and wage expectations at save start, against the league reputation of the buying club. A 170-PA striker nobody can sign is trivia, not a recommendation.
  • Position and role. A wonderkid centre-back and a wonderkid winger are different investments, so they will not share one ranking.
  • League spread. The list deliberately covers second tiers and smaller football countries, because that is where the price gap is.
Fields carried on every entry: name, age, club, position, PA band as read at a named club, fee range at save start, contract length, and the patch the entry was checked on. An entry without a patch number is out of date by definition.

Reading potential before the list lands

Three things worth knowing while you scout your own list in the preview:

  • Stars are relative. A four-star potential at a League Two club is not a four-star potential at a title contender. Judge the band against your squad, not in the abstract.
  • Scout twice, then decide. Two scouts with different judging ability will disagree; the disagreement is information, not noise.
  • Minutes beat potential. A high-PA teenager who cannot get games stalls. Squad depth at his position is part of the valuation.

Where the value usually sits at launch

Historically the first-week bargains come from clubs whose division reputation is below their academy reputation: recently relegated sides, second-tier clubs in strong football countries, and big clubs' reserves where a 19-year-old is fourth choice. The Launch Preview is the moment to check whether that pattern survives the new database.

What this page will not do

No invented names. No attribute screenshots from another site. No "FM27 wonderkid" label on a player only because he is young. If a name is here, it was read in a named build and dated.
